content.short: Ravendex will be a decentralized automated market maker protocol that will enable users to swap and trade native.
content.description: Ravendex is the first non-custodial Decentralized Exchange on the Cardano Blockchain that allows swift and near instant transfer of assets and liquidity between native Cardano tokens and ADA. We are a cross chain exchange on The Cardano Blockchain that operates using the EUTXO model known for it’s unique features like the ability to have shared liquidity be split among different assets on The Cardano Ecosystem.
content.meta: Find out about RavenDEX ($RAVE) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
